newsitem.title: UK: Gowrings welcomes Guinness Peat withdrawal.
newsitem.headline: Gowrings welcomes Guinness Peat withdrawal.

text.p: British fast food and motor dealer Gowrings said it welcomed Guinness Peat Group's decision not to proceed with a hostile offer for it.
Life assurance and investment company Guinness Peat, which owns an estimated 14 percent of Gowrings, said it had called off the bid after being unable to conduct further talks with Gowrings.

"We are now able to devote all our attention to improving the return to our shareholders rather than spending time fighting an unwelcome bid," Gowrings chairman John Fowles said in a statement. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
